name: Flutter Codespace
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y curl git unzip xz-utils zip libglu1-mesa && if [ ! -d "$HOME/flutter" ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b stable $HOME/flutter; fi && echo 'export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"' >> $HOME/.bashrc
